items.original_excerpt: In this work, we analyze publicly available AI usage guidance documents from 35 states in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. … We find that guidance priorities converge on topics anchored in laws such as data privacy and academic integrity, each addressed in 97% of documents. … Instead, we identify notable interdependencies between states with shared citations to non-profit organizations like TeachAI and Code.org, with some states reproducing TeachAI's model guidance near-verbatim, and peer citations concentrating on a few early states such as Oregon and Washington. … No state includes parents as contributors on these documents, and only five include students.

items.original_excerpt: 在數位資訊與AI科技蓬勃發展的時代，培養學生的媒體識讀與思辨能力已成為教育現場的重要課題。 … 教育部國教署115學年度補助46所媒體素養基地學校，實施媒體素養特色課程，其中8校獲選績優學校； … 新北市光華國小將媒體素養融入中高年級校訂課程，不僅帶領學生認識生成式AI、學習辨識深偽（Deepfake）影片，更結合社會領域探討法律議題，讓學生從真實案例中理解媒體資訊與日常生活的關聯。 … 未來，國教署將持續挹注資源，補助地方政府及基地學校透過「區域推廣」模式，拓展績優學校的成功經驗，全面提升國民中小學學生的數位公民素養。

items.original_excerpt: The aim of this study is to examine educational administrators’ opinions about use of AI in educational administration process. … The study was conducted using a qualitative case study design. … Data were collected through a semi-structured interview form and analyzed using content analysis. … The findings revealed that educational administrators primarily define AI as digital tools that perform data analysis, imitate human intelligence, and facilitate routine tasks. … The most common areas of AI use in administration processes were identified as planning, communication and official correspondence, and data analysis.

items.original_excerpt: 교육부(장관 최교진)는 2026학년도 내신평가에서 인공지능(AI) 기능이 탑재된 스마트 안경 관련 부정행위 발생 현황을 전수 조사한 결과, 총 4건의 부정행위가 확인되었다고 밝혔다. … ‣ 조사 대상 : 전국의 모든 중·고등학교 … 이어 2026학년도 2학기 기말고사를 앞둔 11월 3주에는 이번에 조사된 스마트 안경 적발 사례를 담은 학생용 교육자료와 함께, 스마트 안경 관련 부정행위 예방을 위한 현장 유의사항을 안내한다. … 교육부는 앞으로도 인공지능(AI) 등 디지털 기술의 발전에 따른 학생평가 환경 변화에 대응하여, 학교 현장의 평가 공정성과 신뢰성을 확보하기 위한 노력을 지속해 나갈 계획이다.

items.original_excerpt: The Department for Education is proposing a certification scheme to assure the safety of education technology and artificial intelligence (AI) products used in schools and other education settings in England. … Respond by 4 February 2027 … It seeks views on how such a scheme could support safer decision-making, reduce burdens on education settings and give suppliers a clear and proportionate route to demonstrate that their products meet defined safety standards. … Subject to the outcome of this consultation, a minimum of 18 months would be needed to establish the product certification scheme, before products could be certified, followed by a transition period to allow adoption by suppliers and education settings. … Student-facing generative AI products would be assessed against the following eight standards from the generative AI: product safety standards

items.source_title: Orientaciones para la integración de la inteligencia artificial en los centros educativos
items.source_organization: 西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）
items.source_locator: INTEF 新聞頁（2026-11-12 讀取 200）：頁面日期 10-11-2026，datePublished 2026-11-10；摘要歸屬：新聞頁第 2 段、「Alfabetización」軸說明、倒數第 3 段與末段第 2 句
items.original_excerpt: Este documento ofrece recomendaciones para ayudar a los centros a planificar la incorporación de la IA de forma coordinada, de acuerdo con su proyecto educativo y conforme a la normativa vigente. … Alfabetización: desarrollo de conocimientos, capacidades y actitudes que permitan al alumnado y al profesorado comprender, utilizar y valorar críticamente esta tecnología. … Entre las principales líneas de actuación destaca la alfabetización del alumnado y del profesorado, considerada prioritaria para desarrollar competencias necesarias para comprender y utilizar la IA de forma crítica, tanto en el ámbito educativo como en otros contextos. … Las propuestas presentadas tienen carácter orientativo y deben asumirse como recomendaciones, siempre sujetas a la regulación establecida por la Administración educativa competente.
items.claim_text: 來源機構：西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）；資料標題：Orientaciones para la integración de la inteligencia artificial en los centros educativos；來源刊登日：2026-11-10。官方文件表示：西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）發布學校整合 AI 的指引，提供建議協助學校依其教育計畫與現行規範協調地規劃納入 AI；素養（Alfabetización）指發展讓學生與教師能理解、使用並批判評價 AI 的知識、能力與態度，學生與教師的素養被列為優先行動方向；指引內容屬建議性質。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
items.scope_limitation: 西班牙中央機關發布的學校 AI 整合指引（新聞頁轉述），對象為學校與師生；指引為建議性質，須遵循主管教育行政機關的規定；本則依新聞頁，未讀指引全文。
